hashScopes.compiled: Sorted relative file paths and SHA256 values for every server/dist/**/*.js; aggregate SHA256 of compact JSON manifest.
hashScopes.source: Sorted relative file paths and SHA256 values for direct TypeScript files in server/constants,game,schema,systems,rooms; aggregate SHA256 of compact JSON manifest. Source snapshot captured at durable handoff; full runs enforced immutable compiled/tuning hashes.
hashScopes.tuning: SHA256 of JSON.stringify of compiled gameConstants module exports, without formatting.
hashScopes.provenanceCaveat: Git HEAD identifies the checkout. Hashes identify the actual source and existing compiled files; this driver never rebuilds or assumes that an existing build corresponds to HEAD.

method: 30Hz in-process full authoritative GameState updates with seeded Math.random and clock. Normal 20 actors, one human-flagged actor driven by the same ordinary BotBrain plus19 bots. Every system retained production defaults: traffic/bombs/shifts remained disabled; fans/weapons/field/holes/recovery stayed normal. Opening cases start newborn; separate artificial established mixes seed100k/50k/20k gems once, place all bodies with existing safe-spawn search, then leave all decisions/rules unchanged. Five-second population time series plus event/death/leader/life/hole histories retained. No networking/rendering/input latency; not human skill, fun or population-retention evidence.
caveats: Setup giants are not naturally earned progression and consume extra placement RNG; do not interpret as controlled paired comparisons.
Potential size-eligible nearby pairs are five-second geometry-light availability samples; they omit aim, pressure, protection and exact theft/capture eligibility and do not guarantee a catch.
Projectile deaths are explicitly separated from ordinary body deaths. Credit events and actual transitions are separate; cannon events without projectileId mean spent ammunition.
Weapon-owner matchup width is its current body size; it does not imply weapon damage scales with owner mass.
Death causes without a matching same-tick credit remain explicitly uncredited; hitPlayer observations identify uncredited world traffic only.
This is accelerated simulation, not a server load/frame benchmark.
The30-minute seed11 opening repeats its first10minutes; it is not an independent fourth opening seed.
Counts of lives reaching milestones include censored lives still running at the observation boundary; they are not human success probabilities.
Arena-first milestones identify the earliest actor to reach a width, not a typical actor.
Leader can lose rank before later death; zero deaths while first on previous tick does not imply no former leader died.
Current exhale/gustHit/wallSlip are counted; gustHit does not enumerate every front shove or represent unique successful casts.
No human fun, feel, network/input latency, browser/device performance or retention claim is made.
harnessAudit: game-loop-followup.cjs resets PEER_HIT_SHARE=0 even for its default current case and optionally monkeypatches impactGems; not used.
rival-damage-population.cjs intentionally compares0/.25/.33 process-local floors; not used.
balance-playtest.cjs exposes growth/decay/holes overrides, uses1000-gem giant scenarios and coarser minute samples; not used.
game-loop-review.cjs can take a seventh floor override and visible-world policies have old fixed threat heuristics; not reused. Current ordinary BotBrain is used directly.
